item.title: Liza Horvath, Senior Advocate: I am under siege as trustee – should I resign?
item.description: Any legal, financial or tax advice to you, as trustee, stays with “the office of trustee” and if a new trustee were to step in, they would have full access to the legal file that was built while you were acting as trustee. While financial and tax advice is generally not sensitive, legal advice should remain confidential.

item.title: Guest Commentary: CSUMB explains what happened at KAZU
item.description: As a residential campus that provides on-campus housing for nearly 50 percent of its students, Cal State Monterey Bay has been working to increase capacity as our enrollment has increased in recent years. One of the ways we are adding more beds is by converting Gavilan Hall from office space into a residence hall that will be open to students in fall 2026.

item.title: SPCA Monterey County to host annual donation fundraiser
item.description: Beth Brookhouser, vice president of marketing and communications for SPCA Monterey County, said the fundraiser focuses on encouraging the community to support animals and learn more about the organization’s work.

item.title: Monterey Bay Economic Partnership awarded $464K grant for broadband access in tri-county region
item.description: The California Public Utilities Commission recently awarded the Monterey Bay Economic Partnership $463,644 for the three projects as part of grants from the California Advanced Services Fund Broadband Adoption Account to support 21 projects expanding digital literacy training and public broadband access in communities across the state.

item.title: 49ers strike pricey deal with kicker Eddy Piñeiro to keep him off market
item.description: Kicker Eddy Piñeiro is returning to the 49ers on a four-year deal that includes $10 million in guarantees, a source confirmed.
